subject: dwarfBlacksmith
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: dwarf blacksmith at an anvil.
Style: Blizzard/Warcraft.
reasoning:
I'm planning the dwarf blacksmith model with a body hierarchy of joints—spine, head, arms, legs—plus details like the anvil, hammer, beard, and forge glow, keeping the build logic simple and reliable.

Working out head details next—eyes, brows, nose, layered beard with braids, mustache, and a horned helmet. For the arms, I'm positioning the raised right arm gripping a hammer above the anvil, and the left arm bent down to hold something near the workpiece.

Now I'm placing the glowing orange metal bar on the anvil with tongs, building the anvil itself from a stump cylinder plus a tapered body with a horn cone, and refining the hammer-raised hand position. Then I'm setting ground-level leg and boot placement before writing the full code, using b.r for lower limits.

I'm pulling in the glow effect from the kit library and using rod/capsule shapes with bone chains for the limbs, defining joint paths as point arrays for the sweep, and setting arm sweep radii before writing it all out.
